summary: Refactor verification for report_engine.py, joint_engine.py, server.py (_assert_safe_email split) and hardcoded-password removal from tests. Full backend regression: 51/51 pytest passed (48 pre-existing + 3 new shape checks). Educational demo report shape verified (snapshot{total,aligned,different,info}, alignments, differences, child_needs, options, conversation_questions, professional_map, action_plan, summary{aligned,info,conversation,options,priority}, court_map==null, page_titles==10, philosophy). Note: the resend bug flagged in iteration_4 is now fixed (test_resend_ok passes in this run).
